title.narrative: Conservation International - Accelerating Adoption of HQBC Principles & Practitioner’s Guide

description.narrative: The High-Quality Blue Carbon (HQBC) Principles and Guidance, released in 2022, provide a comprehensive and transparent framework to ensure that blue carbon projects are designed and managed in a credible, equitable, and environmentally sustainable way. These principles are intended to guide stakeholders across the blue carbon landscape, from project developers to financiers, ensuring that projects contribute meaningfully to both climate mitigation and the well-being of coastal communities. Under this proposed project, ORRAA with its partners will drive the adoption and implementation of the HQBC principles and guidelines, focusing on key private sector actors, financial institutions, and nature-based carbon credit buyers. Additionally, ORRAA and Conservation International will work to ensure blue carbon project developers integrate these principles, enhancing the quality and impact of future projects. We will offer ongoing product promotion, support and development of tools to ensure effective application of the HQBC Principles.

participating-org.narrative: Conservation International is the implementing organization

recipient-region.narrative: The scope of this project will span the globe.
